source.title: Data on Pregnancy rates, calf weaning weights, and sale prices on the University of Nevada Agricultural Experiment Station’s Gund Ranch from 2008-2020
source.publisher: USDA Ag Data Commons / University of Nevada, Reno

source_issues.note: Value falls outside the row year and conflicts with the declared 2008–2020 annual series; retained as published.
Asterisked values are accompanied by a source note about bull issues; not normalized.

decision.reason: This public-domain package is a single-ranch annual rollup. It has herd reproductive counts and group-average calf sale weights/prices, but no individual adult-cow weights/ADG, animal IDs, or DMI. It cannot supply an animal-level split or validate the approved adult ADG/pasture case.
decision.possible_future_use: A separate descriptive ranch-economics or cow-calf production prototype, subject to explicit scope; do not mix these annual calf outcomes into the current adult ADG dataset.

limitations: One ranch; yearly summaries are not independent animal observations.
The source contains a visibly inconsistent 2010 weaning-start date and asterisked 2017 counts; these values were preserved and flagged.
The source metadata says no use limitations and identifies the package as U.S. Public Domain; attribution and version provenance are still retained.
